project.title: Mahal Kita: A Visual Poem
project.description: The full title of this work is "May Gusto Akong Sabihin Mahal Kita". This was an entry for my org's (KultOU) zine for pride month. This visual poem focuses on the strifes and yearning through the lens of the queer experience. I created this peom and its illustrated visuals as a love letter to the community, to show how deep and profound queer love is.

project.title: Inang Karagatan: An illustration
project.description: This illustration was made for a contest run by the Presidential Office for Maritime Concerns, for their SEANING 2026 Digital Art Competition. This piece was inspired by the beauty and power of our ocean, visualing the sea as a goddess type of being.

project.title: HearthSpice: An Illustrated Novel
project.description: This project is currently ongoing, I made this as a passion project dedicated for my love of food,art, and storytelling. I plan for this to be a hybrid type of novel, wherein some scenes will either be fully illustrated or have a comic style alongside its traditional novel writing. This story revolves around food, specifically magic within it, focusing on an elven heroine as she goes on a fantastical journey of culinary exploration, friendship, love and a bit of mid-stakes fantasy conflict.
